Established: 1963
Legal Basis: DSPE Act, 1946
Type: Statutory Body
Director Tenure: 2 years
Requires State Consent
India’s Premier Investigative Agency

items: Legal foundation is based on the DSPE Act, 1946.
State consent requirement is a frequently tested constitutional jurisdiction point.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: The agency was established in 1963 as India's premier investigative agency.
It derives its legal authority from the DSPE Act, 1946.
It functions as a Statutory Body.
The Director has a mandated tenure of 2 years.
It requires state consent to exercise powers and jurisdiction in a state.
